events.title: Codex supervisor (interactive): ACCEPT
events.detail: Recommend ACCEPT within the illustrative simulation SOP only: all five qualifying 118 h QC records are valid and passing, the delivery problem was independently confirmed and corrected with verified delivery, the culture is complete, and no unresolved adverse process condition is recorded. This is not a real release or comprehensive safety claim.

request.rationale: Only 124.8 mL has been consumed versus roughly 144 mL commanded over 48 h, plus samples. The inventory discrepancy supports checking actual delivery. Obtain a current metabolic panel rather than assuming increased demand.

S-004 independently measured 0.96 mL/h against a 3 mL/h command. Service the delivery path, set moderate perfusion for the growing culture, and verify actual post-service delivery. Current glucose is adequate, so avoid attributing this to biological demand.
The post-service check confirms delivery equals the 6 mL/h command. Update glucose, lactate and cell density to choose the next control action from current biological evidence.
Delivery is verified after service, glucose is ample and lactate is controlled. Continue 6 mL/h until the next scheduled metabolic check.
Scheduled metabolic reassessment after confirmed equipment recovery; use measured growth and metabolites to adjust dilution.
Verified delivery is restored. Growth to 1.985 million cells/mL and rising lactate justify a higher perfusion setting rather than another equipment intervention.
Check whether the higher dilution setting has controlled lactate while preserving viability; do not use the old sample as endpoint evidence.

Current viability is high and delivery was verified. Increase dilution modestly from 10 to 12 mL/h to contain rising lactate, then collect the full qualifying QC panel at 118 h. Report the extra medium cost.
Collect all required identity, phenotype, viability, genomic and microbial evidence close to the endpoint. Wait for actual results rather than treating requested assays as passing.
Do not accept on a passing viability result alone. Culture is complete and the other required independent QC channels must return before disposition.
